title: Create README.md
description: Write comprehensive README.md covering installation, quick start, all commands, backend options, and requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: What Rocket is section is present
Installation instructions (npm install -g rocket-cli) are present
Quick start (rocket new my-app, rocket loop) is documented
Commands reference covers new, loop, init, tasks, feature, status
Backends section documents Copilot, Claude, and Docker options

steps.details: Start with: # Rocket CLI, then a one-paragraph description explaining what Rocket is: an AI-powered CLI that scaffolds projects and runs autonomous development loops.
Add: ## Requirements (Node.js >=22), ## Installation (npm install -g rocket-cli), ## Quick Start with the two-command flow.
Add ## Commands section with subsections for each command: rocket new, rocket loop, rocket init, rocket tasks, rocket feature, rocket status. Include usage, flags, and brief examples.
Add ## Backends table (Copilot, Claude, Docker), ## Templates section (webapp, website descriptions).
